title: Label templates
columnCountHelp: How many labels across the roll; each row prints as one page
fieldsHelp: Shown in the selected order, up to 8; the barcode holds the serial or batch number
defaultHelp: Selected by default when printing; one default per target, and the default cannot be disabled
previewUnavailable: Enter the size and fields to see a preview
unsupportedBarcode: Content has characters a 1D barcode cannot encode
workorderPlaceholder: Filter by work order or batch number
noTemplate: No label template is available yet. Add one under Barcode & trace → Label templates
nothingToPrint: Nothing to print. Select a template and what to print first
printFailed: Could not open printing; check that the browser allows printing
printSummary: {count} labels on {pages} pages, each page {width} × {height} mm
printHint: In the print dialog choose the label printer, set the paper to {width} × {height} mm, margins to None and scale to 100%.
